title: Inverse-image presentation of the constant comparison map
statement: For every morphism of schemes, the pro-etale inverse-image map obtained from the inverse-image adjunction is the adjoint of the canonical constant direct-image map.

source.place: Paragraph (2), definition of the constant-section map and its adjoint

proof.text: Unfold `proEtaleConstantInverseImageMap` and rewrite with `Adjunction.homEquiv_counit`. The resulting pro-etale adjunction is definitionally the same sheaf-pullback adjunction as `upperStarLowerStarAdjunction`, so the two transposes are definitionally equal.

mathlib_searches.results: The project definition is adjunction map followed by counit; no separately proved compatibility lemma is available.

lean.statement: theorem integral_site_pullback_integer_endpoint_inverse_image {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).homEquiv _ _).symm (Scheme.proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap f AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))) = Scheme.proEtaleConstantInverseImageMap f AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))
